Membership

Class

A composition that consists in an actor joining the goals and/or th activities of a group

https://loze-ontology.org/Membership

For example

A person being a member of a household, a person being a member of a club or charity, a person being an employee of a company, a company being a member of a trade association, France being a member of the European Union

Note

In a membership, the main participants are a member (loze:isMemberIn) and a composite (loze:isCompositeIn): the former is the actor that is the member, and the latter is the group of which they are a member

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
